processQuality.label: Process Quality (agent artifacts, governance, transparency)

comparison.p1: Evidence lock, lifecycle reconcile, policy defect intake

processQuality.analysis: Vanilla and v0.4 have minimal process infrastructure. Old v0.5 has rich but heavy process (7 agents). P1 has leaner process (4 agents) with comparable governance rigor.

evidenceQuality.label: Evidence Quality (verifiability, machine-readability, transcript completeness)
evidenceQuality.analysis: P1 has the strongest evidence quality: full test log capture, agent registry with lifecycle reconciliation, and verifier result JSON. Old v0.5 has good process evidence but with 7-agent overhead.

overhead.label: Process Overhead (agent count, spawn rounds, human intervention)

comparison.p1: Some (reviewer block, lifecycle reconcile, R1 repair)

overhead.analysis: P1's overhead (4 agents, 2 spawn rounds) is significantly lower than old v0.5 (7 agents, multiple rounds). P1's human intervention is higher due to BLOCKED_BY_REVIEWER path, but this is a process integrity cost, not a product quality cost.
